name: Manual spring-charging indication
summary: Identifies the mechanically initiated charging state where the selected mechanism provides feedback.
description: Identifies the mechanically initiated charging state where the selected mechanism provides feedback. A stored-energy breaker mechanism has charging, release, indication and supervision functions. Motor supply, stored spring energy and the ability to complete an opening operation are separate drawing concerns.

In a switchgear panel, a charging motor replenishes the mechanism after an operation. Supervisory contacts let the controller report an incomplete charge or repeated charging demand before an operator requests another operation. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Manual charging feedback” at the input and “Manual-charge indication” at the output. Feedback availability depends on the mechanism.
